neighborhoods.name: Hilperton
neighborhoods.notes: former mill workers' housing, conservation area character

property_mix.era: predominantly Victorian and interwar mill-town stock with post-war expansion
property_mix.notable: Historic textile-industry terraces with period locks; growing new-build suburban areas requiring modern security systems

locksmith_relevant: Victorian and Edwardian terraces dominate Hilperton and town centre—many retain original period locks and sash windows requiring specialist attention.
Post-war semi-detached suburbs (Southwick, West Ashton) feature standard mortice and cylinder locks prone to common wear and replacement needs.
Historic conservation areas mean listed-building compliance and heritage-appropriate lock repairs essential for older properties throughout Trowbridge.
